piecewise_frozen_same_selector.definition: Every registered nonuniform base-state interval is divided into r subintervals and A is frozen at each subinterval's left endpoint; P_in, P_out and the metric are identical to the time-ordered reference.

experimental_landmarks.evidence: Peak/ASB times and approximate peak stress are read from Fig. 1; the temperature-rise and localized-temperature intervals are stated in the text.

pure_titanium_literature_comparison.failed_or_unmatched_features: The homogeneous single-crystal path does not reproduce the specimen-scale peak time, the measured temperature rise at that peak, or the post-localization stress collapse; geometry, damage, localization and batch calibration are absent.

source.title: Temperature Rise Associated with Adiabatic Shear Band: Causality Clarified

pure_titanium_literature_comparison.supported_inference: Both histories place the stress maximum before the largest temperature rise.

reoptimization.audit_boundary: Shared scrambled-Sobol reconnaissance plus registered anchors and bounded Powell refinement; this retains and challenges basins but is not a proof of the global optimum.

degeneracy_rule.interpretation: When triggered, only the leading singular subspace may be interpreted; a single singular vector is not assigned a mechanism.
